target: AArch64 QEMU virt with ramfb and VirtIO keyboard/tablet
command: QEMU_VIRT='-machine virt,accel=hvf,gic-version=3 -cpu host -m 1024 -device ramfb -device virtio-keyboard-device -device virtio-tablet-device' python3 scripts/check-compat.py --probe-demo-bomber-golf
checks: Launched the unchanged pinned /Demo/Games/BomberGolf.ZC from the graphical terminal.
The 3D game field rendered without a graphics exception.
Left and Right input each updated the game HUD.
Space triggered a bomb drop and the scene advanced.
Escape restored the graphical terminal; 40+2 evaluated to 42 and zstatus reported failed=0.
scope_note: QEMU runtime acceptance only; live UTM and Pi hardware behavior are not implied.
